stories.headline: Women replant 3 million mangroves on oil-hit Niger Delta land
stories.summary: Since 2018, teams led by Martha Agbani have replanted 3 million mangroves and restored 190 hectares of swamp forest in Ogoniland, a region scarred by oil spills. Fish and crabs are returning.
stories.why: Local women are healing their own land and getting their food and income back.

stories.headline: NASA picks a mission to look for a cave under the Moon
stories.summary: GIMLI will land by the Marius Hills pit and use radar, seismic sensors and a gravity meter to check whether an old lava tube runs underground. Such caves could shelter future astronauts.
stories.why: A natural lunar cave could protect a Moon base from radiation and temperature swings.

stories.stat_label: patients with a newly explained cause
stories.headline: Scientists find a hidden cause of inherited blindness
stories.summary: An international team found that mild faults in the IDUA gene, known for a severe childhood illness, caused sight loss in 14 adults with retinitis pigmentosa who were otherwise healthy.
stories.why: Better diagnosis today, and a clue for treatments that could save sight.

stories.stat_label: shelter dogs taken on backpack rides
stories.headline: A New Yorker carries shelter dogs around the city in a backpack
stories.summary: Bryan Reisberg has given more than 55 adoptable dogs a backpack tour of New York and shared each ride online, putting shelter pups in front of a huge audience of possible owners.
stories.why: A fun day out is helping overlooked dogs get noticed and adopted.

fun_fact: Mangrove roots trap mud and shelter young fish, which is why they're called nurseries of the sea.
